notes: Interactive setup wizard (task 2 Phase B3, closes the guided-onboarding half of the competitive install-experience gap). (1) New deploy/aidog_setup.py behind `aidog setup`: a slot-by-slot wizard over secrets.env (WEB_TOKEN, MYCORE_TG_TOKEN, AIDOG_TG_ALLOWED_USERS, MODEL_API_KEY, AIDOG_GH_PAT, MYCORE_WD_CHAT) plus the model endpoint (web/settings.json mycore.base_url/model). Filled slots are reported as NAME set (len N) and NEVER overwritten (rotation stays a hand edit); secret answers use hidden input on a TTY and no value is ever echoed — output carries slot names and lengths only; every answer is validated against the own-line contract (token formats, comma-separated ids, http(s) URL), an invalid answer is retried up to 3x with the reason and then left empty (pending stays fail-closed); every write is atomic (tmp + os.replace, mode 0600 best-effort) and read back — secrets.env re-parsed line by line (violations reported by line number only, never content) and settings.json re-parsed as JSON; template comments and unrelated lines stay byte-identical. The wizard ends with an optional 'run doctor + boot + verify' question (deploy/install.sh, exit code propagated). (2) Flags: `aidog setup --check` = read-only status report, exit 0 ready / 2 pending (empty or format-invalid required slot) / 1 broken own-line syntax or invalid settings.json — creates nothing; `aidog setup --yes` = the idempotent pre-wizard installer path (provision + boot + verify); `--no-boot` skips the boot leg (wizard question omitted; --yes provisions + reports only); a non-TTY `aidog setup` with no flags falls back to --yes so scripts never block on a prompt (unknown flags exit 2). (3) Dispatch: aidog_persist.py setup subcommand gained --check/--yes/--no-boot and delegates; install.sh/README/installation.md usage updated (wizard is the documented primary path, $EDITOR the manual fallback). (4) Tests: tests/setup_wizard_b3.py = 80/80 offline (stdlib, throwaway fake repo under /tmp with a stub install.sh; the real secrets.env and web/settings.json are never touched) covering zero-echo of piped values, no-overwrite byte-identity, 3-strikes fail-closed, graceful EOF (no traceback, summary still printed), exit-code contracts for --check/--yes/--no-boot, installer exit propagation, non-TTY fallback, and argparse flag handling; registered as a quality gate (HANDOVER §3, PRODUCT_HANDOFF §1.2/§3.4) with docs/features/setup_wizard.md. Competitive doc gap §4.2-6 updated honestly (guided CLI wizard shipped; GUI/one-click public installer package still open) and all PRODUCT_HANDOFF/web/server line refs re-anchored after the inserts. Frontend untouched (owner freeze). Verified: suites mycore 381/381, web smoke 57/57, router 15/15, memory 58/58, setup wizard 80/80, srclint 0 (locale packs en/zh 204 keys parity); doctor 9 active + 20 SKIP 0F/0W on clean tree; publish READY(0); run_service --check rc=0; boot status green; update up-to-date. Real-machine E2E (before these notes were finalized): `aidog setup --check` rc=0 with zero writes; interactive keep-everything run left secrets.env/settings.json md5-identical; `aidog setup --yes --no-boot` rc=0 read-only on slots; `bash deploy/install.sh` READY (rc=0) with secrets.env md5 unchanged.
